import json, random, subprocess, sys, copy
PROG='/app/submission/scheduler.py'
def run(req):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',PROG],input=json.dumps(req).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr[:300]
    return json.loads(p.stdout)
base=json.load(open('/app/dev/hand1.json'))
o0=run(base)
rnd=random.Random(5)
for trial in range(30):
    req=copy.deepcopy(base)
    for s in req['steps']:
        rnd.shuffle(s['arrivals'])
    if run(req)!=o0:
        print('PERMUTATION MISMATCH', trial); sys.exit(1)
print('permutation invariance OK (30 trials)')
# bigger: random stream with many multi-lane steps
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/dev')
from fuzz import gen_stream
for trial in range(20):
    req=gen_stream(random.Random(1000+trial))
    a=run(req)
    req2=copy.deepcopy(req)
    for s in req2['steps']:
        rnd.shuffle(s['arrivals'])
    b=run(req2)
    if a!=b:
        print('PERM MISMATCH big', trial); sys.exit(1)
print('permutation invariance OK (20 random)')
EOF
